name: kineglyph
description: Deterministic, themeable technical illustrations with motion and interaction.

scripts.typecheck: npm run bootstrap && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/core && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/svg && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/export && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/anime && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/plot && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/scenes && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/web && npm run build --workspace @kineglyph/react
scripts.check:clean: npm run clean && npm run check
